decisions.thought: Incineroar leads well: Intimidate weakens the physical attackers (Garchomp, Kingambit, Dragonite), and Fake Out or Parting Shot gives tempo. Garchomp is fast and threatens Earthquake into Kingambit and Gholdengo, and Gholdengo's special coverage handles Primarina and Dragonite.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
I need to pick 3 from our team against their lineup of garchomp, gholdengo, incineroar, primarina, dragonite, and kingambit. Incineroar seems like a solid lead with intimidate to weaken their physical threats like garchomp, kingambit, and dragonite, while Gholdengo's Shadow Ball could pressure Kingambit effectively.

Garchomp's Earthquake hits Kingambit and Gholdengo super effectively since both are Steel-type, so Garchomp pulls real weight here. I'll settle on Incineroar as leader alongside Garchomp and Gholdengo.
